 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAURABH BANER  ORDER % 19.09.2023 1.

The petitioners vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seek quashing of FIR No.248/2017 dated 10.08.2017 registered under Sections 415/417/418/420/403/405/406/409/34/120/120A/120B IPC at Police Station New Friends Colony, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom, in view of the settlement arrived at between the parties.
W.P.(CRL) 2240/2023 page 1 of 3

This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Agreement dated 11.12.2020 [Annexure-P-4] and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2 through its Directors Sh.
Sanajay Kumar Mandal, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.

sentences.text: Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
5. Learned ASC for the State accepts notice.
She confirms that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 affirms the Settlement Agreement dated 11.12.2020 and submits that he has voluntarily settled all disputes with the petitioners.
He further states that he does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the petitioners and has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

7. In view of the fact that the settlement has been arrived at between the parties, and as the respondent no.2 does not wish to continue with the criminal proceedings, in order to bring a quietus to the present disputes and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr.
(2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.

Accordingly, the petition is allowed and FIR No.248/2017 dated 10.08.2017 registered under Sections 415/417/418/420/403/405/406/409/34/120/120A/120B IPC at Police Station New Friends Colony, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed, subject to the petitioner no.2 depositing a cost of Rs.1,00,000/- to Maher NGO [IDBI Bank, Branch: Kalyani Nagar, Bank Account Name: Maher, Bank Account No.034104000033202, IFSC Code- IBKL0000034] and petitioner no.1 and respondent no.5 depositing a cost of Rs.1,00,000/- each to the Himachal Pradesh Aapada Raahat Kosh (Account Name: Aapada Raahat Kosh, Account No.40610107381,
IFSC Code; HPSCO000406).
9.
This Court applauds the goodwill gesture shown by the each of the petitioner nos.1 and 2 and the respondent no.5 for stepping ahead in providing relief to the State of Himachal Pradesh and NGO.
10. The petition alongwith the pending application stands disposed of.

11. List the matter for compliance on 18.10.2023.
